instagram.caption:
The half-used chemicals.
The Lawn and Garden Tool Zone in the Garage. Stores the yard tools and outdoor supplies so long handles stay off the floor and garden chemicals stay latched away from everything else.

What done looks like:
1. Every long-handled tool hanging head-up on the rail with nothing leaning in a corner
2. The hose coiled on its reel beside the door it goes out of
3. All garden chemicals in their original labelled containers behind a latch above head height

Free written steps for this zone, no signup: link in bio, or search 6S Success lawn and garden tool zone.
